checks_passed: Exact fixed plan SHA is enforced.
Exactly six planned native artifacts are selected, with fixed local destinations.
The native path is required inside the exact owned site unit.
Remote source and local verifier require ordinary owned files and compare fd identity before/after reads.
Driver files use exact known byte counts; logs retain explicit unknown expected sizes and bounded maximum sizes.
Existing-master SSH transport uses ControlMaster=no, ProxyCommand=false and BatchMode=yes, with no authentication or transfer retry loop.
No source program loads or executes the fetched driver image.
The utility does not submit, release, cancel or query Slurm jobs.
Data files are exclusive-created and receipts declare no scientific or worker-admission credit.

findings.observed: The verifier always requests a five-minute Slurm step after transport may have consumed most of the same file total deadline. The local subprocess.run timeout kills/reaps its srun client, without proving the allocated hash step or its blocking flock has ended.
findings.required_correction: Bound the actual verifier and lock acquisition within the remaining per-file time, retain cleanup time, and prove owned step termination on failure; no automatic retry or unrelated job action.

findings.observed: A nonzero SSH transport status leaves error=None, writes verified=false and a summary, then main returns normally zero. The outer exception handler does not write fetch_failure.json.
findings.required_correction: Preserve the partial bytes, intent and fetch receipt, then fail nonzero and save fetch_failure.json for a nonzero transport result.

findings.observed: Both embedded readers check path.resolve()==path before opening, but post-read path.stat follows links. A symlink to the same already-open file can pass the final identity tuple despite the fixed plan refusing symlink paths.
findings.required_correction: Recheck the canonical/no-symlink path and its final path identity after the read, keeping the existing fd before/after checks.

review_method: Whole-source and exact-plan inspection plus AST parsing of both embedded programs; no utility execution, live fixture, SSH, artifact fetch, Slurm action or numerical/library operation.
